semantic_precheck.rule: Source-area records require Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry plus evidence_scope=coverage_area, coverage_area_id, source_resolution, time_window, source_url, measurement_date, measurement_method, spatial_binding_method, confidence_score_0_100, evidence_grade, field_evidence.
semantic_precheck.rejection_reason: Official BGC MapServer layer-definition window was selected, but no layer JSON, extent, Polygon/MultiPolygon payload, or exact identifier payload was acquired; mandatory coverage-area evidence fields cannot be populated without fabrication.
